snippet.title: WISHLIST ASTRAL COURT DX
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4568830/ASTRAL_COURT_DX/

That's right baby, my first ever Steam release shall be Astral Court DX!! Getting everything set up wasn't actually that hard, aaand now I have a Steam page! Ughh it's such a cool feeling, I'm one of the big dogs now (not really)!!! Hopefully I'll get one set up for Outer Outage at some point too.

Stay tuned, folks! As we approach closer to the (secret) planned release window for Astral Court DX, I'll sure have some exciting stuff to show!
